ABI_derivation: abi-layout.json is source-only LP64 natural-C alignment arithmetic over exact installed declarations; all11 ctypes struct sizes/alignments/represented field offsets are checked before loading Vulkan. No compiler/ctypes/provider execution during preparation.
cache_policy: Default/unset. software_provider:true, disable_software_shader_cache:false; only VK_DRIVER_FILES=LVP and SIRIUS_VULKAN_DEVICE=0; no LP/MESA tuning.
claim_limits: Physical property support/profile eligibility only. No logical device or shader created; no numerical, latency, frame, global-property, arithmetic or release qualification.
RTE32+Float64 mixed-width validity is independent of estimate accuracy. RTE64 is observed only and is not inferred/required.
Actual query/reader/owner/input/map evidence does not exist at source preparation time.
float_controls_preserved: All17 non-header fields, including both independence enums and15 Bool32 flags; all55 supported core features preserved separately from enablement.
future_capture_join: Bind actual accepted property result and its retired owners/raw inputs/maps to the same exact loader/provider/LLVM/device0 identity and fresh public Float64-enabled VkDevice args before capture. Property support alone does not establish logical-device enablement or estimate precision.
maps_context: While instance alive, retain exact /proc/self/maps plus each image range/perms/offset/path/device/inode/bytes/SHA256 and PID/start_ticks/session/boot. Paths/inodes must match frozen regular files; recheck mappings after hashing.
observation_versus_profile: A complete query writes observed properties even if profile_admissible:false. The separate root-owned pure reader refuses profile admission unless all four original profile checks pass; no unsupported device/property becomes accuracy evidence.

provider_dependency_pin_source.scope: Exact accepted dependency pin reuse only; no fresh provider library hash/query by preparer. Actual root-owned query must match all frozen current bytes before CDLL; mature owner checks whole-input stability before/after.
